---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement for FerrumEngine
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: enhancement, triage
assignees: ''
---

## Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Who is affected?

Example: "When browsing 542 effects, I can't filter by complexity level, so finding beginner-friendly effects takes too long."

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like. Be as specific as possible.

- What does the user do?
- What does the UI look like?
- What data changes (if any)?

## Alternatives Considered

Have you tried any workarounds? Are there other approaches that might work?

## Mockups / Examples

If applicable, add mockups, screenshots, or links to similar features in other tools.

## Additional Context

- Does this fit the project's scope? (See README for what FerrumEngine is)
- Is this a breaking change?
- Any related issues/PRs?

## Willingness to Contribute

- [ ] I'd like to implement this myself
- [ ] I can help with design/UX
- [ ] I can help with testing
- [ ] Just wanted to suggest it
